overview: Library of pre-built, industry-specific voice agents with an embeddable inbound-call widget and a live demo.

blocks.p: The agency needed specialised voice agents for many verticals, plus a way for prospects to try them live on its website.

Pre-built voice agents for a wide range of industries, deployable per client, packaged with an embeddable inbound-call widget and a live demo on the agency's site. Built with Synthflow, Vapi, ElevenLabs, GoHighLevel and n8n.
